about_the_game:
Travel through various dangerous locales on your mission to study unexplained phenomena. This trial version includes 4 of the games 30 levels, as well as the training level to get you up to speed. All available from the beginning, these set of levels demonstrate the variety in gameplay. This demo feature a mixture of early and late levels, to gently introduce players as well as challenge those who seek a thrill.

Note: Saved data and settings do not carry to the full version.
